rationale: Extends the confirmed recovery finding to the deployed variant: the shipped configuration designates one replica as leader, so a promoted replica's recovery raises its ballot past maxRecvBallot, and this check observes whether the COMMITTED reply is then still ignored. The harness is the reviewed driven variant with IsLeader true and a ballot history; the local construction run shows the same outcome (new ballot 6 reported as the self VBallot, adopted_committed false, vectors_match false), and the formal observation and a fresh correspondence review decide it. The non-promoted claim C1 is untouched, and this claim's scope is the promoted variant only.

candidate.rationale: The obligation and binding are supplied with the check so the claim exists before the plan references it; the duty is the same as C1's but scoped to the deployment's promoted replica, whose ballot arithmetic differs.

question.question: When the replica the deployment promoted to leader (IsLeader true, and a ballot history above its ballot base) recovers an instance and a slow-quorum reply reports that instance COMMITTED, does it adopt the committed vector, or does raising the new ballot past maxRecvBallot make its own VBallot outrank the committed reply so the recovery restarts phase 1 with NOOP?
question.importance: The shipped configuration designates one replica as leader, so the promoted variant is the deployed case rather than an artificial one. If the same masking occurs there, the confirmed agreement failure applies to deployments that use the shipped configuration, and the divergence it produces is reachable by the replica most likely to be asked to recover instances.

peer holding the instance COMMITTED with a real command

the peer's COMMITTED reply arrives at an older vbal
handlePrepareReply resolves and either adopts the committed vector or restarts phase 1

question.trigger_rationale: This is the same A2 relationship as the confirmed finding, under the variant the shipped configuration produces: the ballot context decides which value a leadership transfer may adopt, and the deployment's leader flag changes the ballot the recovering replica uses.

obligation.description: When a replica that the deployment promoted to leader (IsLeader true, with a ballot history) recovers an instance and a slow-quorum reply reports that instance COMMITTED with a command vector, the recovering replica must adopt that committed vector rather than restarting phase 1 with a different command.

scope.description: Promoted-leader variant on the captured snapshot: N=3 with Thrifty, the recovering replica has IsLeader true and a maxRecvBallot above its own ballot base, one peer holds the instance COMMITTED with a real command, and the recovering replica holds a default record for it.
assumptions: the recovering replica is the replica the master designated through Replica.BeTheLeader
a slow quorum (its own entry plus one reply) is sufficient to resolve
excluded: the non-promoted variant, which claim C1 covers
producing the committed record through a proposal round

grounding.derivation: The master designates one replica as leader in the shipped configuration and calls Replica.BeTheLeader on it, which sets IsLeader; makeBallot then raises the new ballot past maxRecvBallot. Because startRecoveryForInstance reports that new ballot as the recovering replica's own VBallot, the element.VBallot >= lb.ballot comparison in handlePrepareReply skips a reply whose committed value sits at an older vbal, exactly as in the non-promoted case, so the duty to adopt the reported committed vector is the same while the variant differs in ballot arithmetic. The duty is bound to the already accepted recovery-entry binding (BB1-recovery-start), which documents startRecoveryForInstance and the vbal it publishes.
grounding.applicability: Applies to the replica the deployment promotes while it recovers an instance whose committed value another replica still holds.
unresolved: the ballot history of a real promoted replica is modelled as a single maxRecvBallot value

associations.rationale: The entry and the resolution together decide whether an older-vbal committed reply is adopted; the promoted-leader variant only changes the ballot value, not the comparison.

bindings.description: Recovery entry under the promoted-leader variant: the new ballot is raised past maxRecvBallot and is then reported as the recovering replica's own VBallot.
